story.text: 이른 아침, 좁은 골목길 사이로 옅은 햇살이 스며들었다. 아직 잠이 덜 깬 눈으로 현관문을 나서자, 시원한 아침 공기가 뺨을 스쳤다.
story.reading: i-reun a-chim, jop-eun gol-mok-gil sa-i-ro yeot-eun haet-sal-i seu-myeo-deul-eot-da. a-jik jam-i deol kkaen nun-eu-ro hyeon-gwan-mun-eul na-seo-ja, si-won-han a-chim gong-gi-ga ppyam-eul seu-chyeot-da.
story.en: Early in the morning, faint sunlight seeped through the narrow alley. Stepping out the front door with eyes still heavy with sleep, the cool morning air brushed my cheek.

story.text: 골목 어귀에는 규현이 커피 두 잔을 든 채 벽에 기대 서 있었다. "좋은 아침이에요, 아가씨." 그가 씩 웃으며 손을 흔들었다.
story.reading: gol-mok eo-gwi-e-neun gyu-hyeon-i keo-pi du jan-eul deun chae byeok-e gi-dae seo iss-eot-da. "jo-eun a-chim-i-e-yo, a-ga-ssi." geu-ga ssik us-eu-myeo son-eul heun-deul-eot-da.
story.en: At the mouth of the alley, Kyuhyun stood leaning against the wall, holding two cups of coffee. "Good morning, miss." He grinned and waved.

story.text: "오늘도 늦게 일어났죠? 눈이 반쯤 감겨 있는데요." 그가 눈을 찡긋하며 커피 한 잔을 내밀었다.
story.reading: "o-neul-do neut-ge il-eo-nat-jyo? nun-i ban-jjeum gam-gyeo it-neun-de-yo." geu-ga nun-eul jjing-geut-ha-myeo keo-pi han jan-eul nae-mil-eot-da.
story.en: "Got up late again today, didn't you? Your eyes are half shut." He winked and held out a cup of coffee.

story.text: "그쪽은 몇 시부터 여기 있었는데요?" 내가 커피를 받아 들며 묻자, 그는 "잘 잤으면 그걸로 됐죠, 뭐." 하며 능청스럽게 시선을 돌렸다.
story.reading: "geu-jjok-eun myeot si-bu-teo yeo-gi iss-eot-neun-de-yo?" nae-ga keo-pi-reul bad-a deul-myeo mut-ja, geu-neun "jal jat-eu-myeon geu-geol-lo dwaet-jyo, mwo." ha-myeo neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge si-seon-eul dol-lyeot-da.
story.en: "How long have you been standing here?" I asked, taking the coffee. "As long as you slept well, that's all that matters," he said, smoothly looking away.

story.text: 한 모금 마신 커피는 따뜻했고, 아침 공기는 유난히 상쾌했다. 오랜만에 느끼는 개운한 기분이었다.
story.reading: han mo-geum ma-sin keo-pi-neun tta-tteut-haet-go, a-chim gong-gi-neun yu-nan-hi sang-kwae-haet-da. o-raen-man-e neu-kki-neun gae-un-han gi-bun-i-eot-da.
story.en: The sip of coffee was warm, and the morning air was unusually refreshing. It was a clean, clear feeling I hadn't had in a while.

story.text: "자, 그럼 우리 하루를 시작해 볼까요?" 규현이 씩 웃으며 앞장서 걸었다. 그의 발걸음에는 여유가 묻어났다.
story.reading: "ja, geu-reom u-ri ha-ru-reul si-jak-hae bol-kka-yo?" gyu-hyeon-i ssik us-eu-myeo ap-jang-seo geol-eot-da. geu-ui bal-geol-eum-e-neun yeo-yu-ga mud-eo-nat-da.
story.en: "Well then, shall we start our day?" Kyuhyun grinned and walked ahead. There was an easy confidence in his stride.

story.text: 뒤따라 걸으며, 나는 오늘 하루가 왠지 나쁘지 않을 것 같다는 예감이 들었다.
story.reading: dwi-tta-ra geol-eu-myeo, na-neun o-neul ha-ru-ga waen-ji na-ppeu-ji anh-eul geot gat-da-neun ye-gam-i deul-eot-da.
story.en: Following behind him, I had a feeling that today, somehow, wouldn't turn out so bad.

words.example_en: I drank coffee in the morning.

words.meaning: to get up, to wake up
words.example_en: I got up at seven o'clock.
I start my day with a cup of coffee.

sentences.en: Have a good day today too.
What are you going to do today?
